SoftEtherVPN_5.2.5189_gcc13_x64_libcedar.notes: The Developer Edition 5.x (SoftEtherVPN/SoftEtherVPN, tag 5.2.5189), built with upstream's RelWithDebInfo CMake configuration; the artefacts are libcedar.so and libmayaqua.so, which hold the code - vpnserver, vpnbridge, vpnclient and vpncmd are 46-line mains calling into libcedar. OpenSSL, zlib, readline, ncurses and libsodium are linked dynamically. liboqs, the OQS provider and cpu_features (static, in libmayaqua.so) and BLAKE2's blake2s (in libcedar.so) are excluded by exact name: every function defined in their archives or objects of this build and in none of SoftEther's (_softether5_vendored.py). -Wl,-Bsymbolic-functions keeps calls inside each library off unnamed PLT stubs. Measured x64: libcedar.so 5179 kept + 4 glue + 7 excluded = 5190, libmayaqua.so 2615 + 4 + 1226 = 3845 (liboqs 860, OQS provider 261, cpu_features 105).
